title: vault-config.yaml — /review setup for one period kind
description: Canonical input contract for `scripts/vault-config-writer.py review` (spec 045 ADR-5, spec 046 ADR-3). One confirmed setup for one period kind. The writer edits only the config keys the input names — concepts.calendar.granularities.<weekly|monthly|quarterly>, naming.calendar_patterns.<g>, templates.mapping.<g> and the review: section — and leaves every other byte of vault-config.yaml unchanged. An optional key that is absent changes nothing; a null template or template_variant removes the config key; an empty sections or off_limits list removes that template's entry. The week rule is required for kind week and not accepted for kind month or quarter. The daily folder path is corrected only when daily_path_fix is present. sections and off_limits are stored per template (review.<g>.sections.<template>, review.<g>.off_limits.<template>) and need a named template.

trimmed.description: A non-empty string with no whitespace at either end.

level.description: Level of a template heading; the template analysis knows levels 2..6.

parent.description: Text of the nearest higher heading; null for a heading with none above it.

occurrence.description: 1-based position among identical (heading, level, parent) in the template.

group.description: A spec 045 group named as a section's starting point (PRD F2-AC7); never habits, which a script computes and which always stay in the Tomo Review section. Narrowed per kind by the allOf branches.

id.description: Opaque row id, unique per template, kept across corrections (ADR-10).

heading.description: Heading text verbatim from the template, %% fold %% kept.

description.description: What the section asks for, as the user confirmed it.

keywords.description: Optional words that point items to this section.

groups.description: Optional spec 045 groups the section starts from (F2-AC7).

placement.description: before | under | end of the mapped heading; review = an analysis row whose text lands in the Tomo Review section (F2-AC12).

cap.description: Most items the section takes; the reader's default is 8.

offLimitsRow.description: One template heading Tomo never writes into (review.<kind>.off_limits.<template>[]).

with_subsections.description: true = the mark covers every heading below this one too.

needsTemplate.description: Rows are stored under the template name, so a present sections or off_limits needs a non-null template.

kind.description: The period kind this setup is for; selects the weekly, monthly or quarterly keys.

folder.description: Vault folder of the periodic notes (concepts.calendar.granularities.<kind>.path); enabled is set to true.

format.description: Moment-style name format (naming.calendar_patterns.<kind>), e.g. GGGG-[W]WW or YYYY-MM; checked by period.check_format under the input's week rule.

first_day.description: First day of the week (review.week.first_day); kind week only.

min_days.description: Days of the new year week 1 must hold (review.week.min_days_in_first_week); 4 = ISO, 1 = week 1 contains 1 January; kind week only.

template.description: Template filename under templates.base_path (templates.mapping.<kind>); null removes the mapping key; absent leaves it as it is.

template_variant.description: Tomo-ready variant of a Templater template (review.<kind>.template_variant); null removes the key.

heading.description: Text of the review heading without # marks (review.<kind>.heading).

anchor.description: Text of the heading the review section is placed at (review.<kind>.place.anchor).

placement.description: before = at the anchor's level above it; inside = one level deeper at the end of its section. after is never accepted (ADR-3).

own_sections.description: Headings of the periodic note the user writes by hand (review.<kind>.own_sections).

sections.description: Mapped sections of the named template (review.<kind>.sections.<template>); [] removes that template's entry.

off_limits.description: Headings of the named template Tomo never writes into (review.<kind>.off_limits.<template>); [] removes that template's entry.

skip_sections.description: Daily-note sections never read, prefix match on the heading text (review.daily.skip_sections).

task_notes.description: Vault paths of living task notes (review.daily.task_notes).

language.description: Review language as a BCP 47 primary tag with an optional subtag (review.language), e.g. de, en, pt-BR.

daily_path_fix.description: Corrected daily folder path (concepts.calendar.granularities.daily.path); present only when the user confirmed the correction.
